intent: A circular hue/saturation color well for grade controls (Shadows / Midtones / Highlights): hue around the disc, saturation from the neutral center to the edge, with a draggable center handle.
use_when: A tonal-grade push (a hue and an amount) — the video color-wheels UI.
dont_use_when: Picking an exact color — use ColorInput / ColorDialog.
A single scalar value — use Slider or Dial.

tokens.note: DS CSS-variable theming for the chrome; the hue disc is an intrinsic generated color gradient (a rainbow), not tokenizable.

code.example: <ColorWheel ariaLabel="Midtones" hue={hue} saturation={sat} onChange={(h, s) => setGrade(h, s)} />
